annotations.text:
TODAY

Nine sections, all the same visual weight. Nothing leads, so the eye has nowhere to land. The active booking — the one thing you care about when you have one — is section 4, below a greeting and a search bar.

REDESIGN

Five sections instead of nine, in priority order:
1. Live booking, full width, dark — the loudest thing on screen when it exists
2. "Where to?" — the product thesis gets the hero
3. Beach map promoted to the front page with a live free-spot count
4. One 8-tile discovery grid, replacing 4 bento groups + wilaya bubbles
5. One editorial row

DARK

Using the app's real dark tokens — bg #0D0D0D, card #121212, border #222222. 34 screens currently hardcode light values and would break here; this is what they should resolve to.

ARABIC — REAL RTL

Not just translated strings: the layout mirrors. Avatar right, bell left; arrows and the search glyph flip; the LIVE badge moves to the right edge; carousels scroll right-to-left. Tajawal for Arabic, Western digits and دج as Algeria writes them.

The map itself is NOT mirrored — geography stays put, only the chrome flips.

OPEN QUESTIONS

· Photography is the big missing piece — these use drawn placeholders. Real Algerian imagery is what will make it feel like yours.
· Does the beach map deserve the front page year-round, or only in season?
